## Reading

Loukissas, Introduction, pp. 1–12. Read it closely before the session.

## Reading summary

Loukissas argues that a dataset is not a complete and portable object. Data are made by people and machines at specific times and places, with specific tools and for specific audiences. He proposes that we study **data settings**, not only data sets. A data setting includes the conditions that make the data possible and meaningful.

## In class

Students turn this idea into a first set of questions for reading data critically.

## Output

A first set of Data Setting questions.
